individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrograph images, not a plot.

Panel B shows time-course (line/scatter) plots of intensity over time, including insets of averaged early time-point responses; line plots are exempt from the requirement to overlay individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A consists of micrograph images, not a plot.
The insets in panel B display average responses with visible error bars, but the caption only describes what the insets represent without stating what the error bars quantify (e.g., SD, SEM, or CI).
